sents.zh: 一百多年以前，上海还是一个小地方。
sents.en: A hundred years ago and more, Shanghai was still a small place.

sents.zh: 很多国家的人在这里住下来。
sents.en: People from many countries settled here.

sents.zh: 他们带来了新的东西和新的想法。
sents.en: They brought new things and new ideas.
And newspapers that came out every day.
At night the streets were still bright.

sents.zh: 老的中国和新的东西都在这里。
sents.en: The old China and the new things were both here.

sents.zh: 有的人喜欢，有的人不喜欢。
sents.en: Some people liked it, some did not.

sents.zh: 上海的变化就是那时候中国的变化。
sents.en: Shanghai’s change was China’s change in those years.
